method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Common converters
features.detail: length, temperature, area, volume, weight, time
features.verse_evidence: convert/index.html Kind select: Length, Weight and mass, Temperature, Volume, Area, Time

features.name: Speed, pressure, energy, power, force, angle, fuel consumption, data storage
Many units per kind
features.detail: long unit lists per converter (e.g. length has dozens incl. historic units)
features.verse_evidence: 495 units in 52 kinds: length adds dm, pm, angstrom, hand, US survey foot, fathom, link, rod, chain, league, cable, parsec, megametre; mass, volume, area, speed, time, pressure, energy and power each gain theirs (lib/units.js)

features.name: Engineering converters
features.detail: acceleration, angular velocity, density, specific volume, moment of inertia, torque
features.verse_evidence: Acceleration, Angular velocity, Density, Specific volume, Torque, Moment of inertia kinds (lib/units.js, group engineering)

features.name: Heat converters
features.detail: thermal conductivity plus fuel efficiency, thermal expansion, thermal resistance, specific heat, heat flux density, heat transfer coefficient
features.verse_evidence: thermal conductivity plus specific heat capacity, heat flux density, heat transfer coefficient; fuel efficiency is the common Fuel kind

features.name: Fluids converters
features.detail: flow rate plus mass and mole flow, concentration, viscosity (dynamic and kinematic), surface tension, permeability
features.verse_evidence: flow rate plus mass flow rate, dynamic and kinematic viscosity, molar concentration

features.name: Light converters
features.detail: illuminance plus luminance, luminous intensity, digital image resolution, frequency to wavelength
features.verse_evidence: illuminance plus luminance; frequency on its own kind

features.name: Electricity converters
features.detail: charge plus current, voltage (electric potential), resistance, resistivity, conductance, capacitance, inductance, field strength, charge densities
features.verse_evidence: charge plus current, voltage, resistance, resistivity, conductance, conductivity, capacitance, inductance, electric field strength

features.name: Magnetism converters
features.detail: flux density plus magnetomotive force, field strength, magnetic flux
features.verse_evidence: flux density plus field strength, magnetic flux, magnetomotive force

features.name: Radiology converters
features.detail: absorbed dose, radioactivity, radiation exposure, equivalent dose
features.verse_evidence: absorbed dose, radioactivity and radiation exposure (C/kg, roentgen)

features.name: Other converters
features.detail: metric prefixes, data transfer rate, typography, lumber volume, molar mass, number bases
features.verse_evidence: metric prefixes, data transfer rate and typography kinds on /convert/; number bases on /base-converter/; no lumber volume or molar mass

features.name: Periodic table
features.detail: an element table among the tools

features.name: One page per unit pair with a conversion table
features.detail: e.g. inch to cm page with a table of common values

features.name: Formula for each pair
